d: The CSIs investigate a brutal murder after two office-mates plan to rob a casino.
The CSIs investigate when a cop shoots a fellow officer dead.
A wealthy teen is abducted and his girlfriend is murdered. The killers demand a ransom but they also demand that Lt. Stone deliver the ransom payment.
A young girl transforms from modeling to prostitution and finding this an easy living. Her angry father swears to "clean the impurities" by killing those who hire her.
A rising rock band has an abusive agent who is found murdered. An eye witness is murdered later and the lead singer who has seizures is the prime suspect.
Kane knows The Ghost is now closer than ever…Kane and his team have removed The Ghost’s support systems but fall under attack when they try to secure the suitcase nukes.
Kane and his team put the pieces together and figure out things aren’t exactly how they appear…
Kane maneuvers to get a shot at the Ghost – but the FBI has taken notice of Kane’s activities and they want him stopped.
Kane’s team sacrifices everything to get him close enough to get his shot at the Ghost…
When his daughter takes part in an anti-nuclear rally, Kessler is suspected of leaking classified information that leads directly to nuclear sabotage.
ICS must find a sadistic kidnapper before he auctions off his 12-year-old victim on a pedophile website.
Kessler discovers a Croatian war criminal has been granted amnesty, and must struggle with demons from his own past in Bosnia.
Three American soldiers plunge into the Niagara River and swim to Canada. Deserters, refusing to return to Iraq under the U.S.’s “stop loss” policy, they  seek refugee status in Canada.

An international assassin, Monita Persaud,  turns up in downtown Toronto. Her target: a political cartoonist who has enraged the Muslim world. The ICS squad  tracks down Persaud, only to discover a more ominous conspiracy.
The CSIs are called to a murder in a bowling alley.
Henry's surprise birthday celebration turns into a disaster when the gang discovers a body
Ray and Nick discover the corpse of a boy, and several body parts. Is Dr Jekyll back?
A couple is caught by the mob for laundering money. When the husband is abducted and believed killed, Stone and Robins must protect the wife because she is the prime witness.
A frustrated teenage girl witnesses the mob killing the man who abused her mother. To hurt her family's reputation and humiliate her mother, she falsely claims responsibility for the crime.

Larry Wilson is a motorcycle cop who doesn't always use procedure. Instead he zeros on the point and rushes to it sometimes lacking caution. Stone is frustrated by the rambunctious officer, who happens also to be dating his daughter.
